description: We are PyCoders, a student team from IUBAT in Dhaka, Bangladesh, working on the "Dancing with the SARs" challenge. Our project, FloodCast Radar, uses NASA-ISRO NISAR radar data to detect and map monsoon floods through cloud cover. It tracks new flooding across all 64 districts of Bangladesh every 12 days on a simple interactive map for disaster managers, NGOs and communities.
